Examine the physical evidence, analyze witness statements, and complete the deduction matrix to unmask the true culprit and recover the murder weapon.
clues: The French Diplomat was confirmed to be in Private Salon.
The Jewel Merchant was discovered carrying the Dosed Champagne.
The investigator found the Luggage Strap inside Engine Cab.
The Train Conductor was never seen near Engine Cab.
The Train Conductor had no access to the Dosed Champagne.
The weapon recovered from Observation Lounge was definitely not the Dosed Champagne.
Neither The Train Conductor nor The Retired General had ever visited Private Salon.
The lethal strike occurred in Observation Lounge, leaving behind the deadly Engraved Pocket Pistol.
